title: Radio
summary: Radio reception and decoding. Use an RTL-SDR USB receiver. The toolkit has the tools of rtl-sdr, multimon-ng (POCSAG, AFSK, DTMF) and Direwolf (APRS, packet).
consent: Most of these tools receive only. Direwolf can transmit if you attach a radio. You need the authorisation that the law requires to transmit. rtl_tcp of rtl-sdr listens on the box for a client only when you start it.
notes: rtl_test -t shows whether the box detects the RTL-SDR USB receiver. Pipe rtl_fm into multimon-ng to decode pagers and AFSK. Direwolf with a USB sound card and a radio is an APRS digipeater or iGate.
This toolkit does not control Meshtastic radios. Use meshtasticd and the Meshtastic page of the hub.
